title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
description_clean:
Your mission
About L1VE
L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.  
As we continue to grow, we are looking for a full-time Head of Finance to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will take overall responsibility for the further development of our finance function in Germany and Europe and create the financial structures and decision-making foundations for L1VE’s next phase of growth.  
Your Role
As Head of Finance, you will act as a strategic partner to our CFO in New York and the executive team. You will translate the overarching finance strategy into scalable finance, controlling and reporting structures, as well as robust planning and management models.
You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will develop financial models and scenarios, evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management.
In this role, you will work closely with the CFO, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners. A particular focus will be on international legal entity and intercompany structures, licensing and revenue-share models, as well as the further development of KPI, forecasting and reporting processes.
Your Responsibilities

Develop and implement L1VE’s finance architecture for Germany and Europe, with a focus on growth, profitability, transparency and international scalability
Own integrated financial planning, budgeting, business cases, financial models, forecasts and scenarios as a basis for strategic decision-making
Build and further develop relevant KPI systems for Technology, Commercial, Product, Marketing and Sales
Evaluate business models, investments, partnerships, licensing models and growth options, including their financial opportunities, risks and implications
Support financing rounds, investor readiness, due diligence and the preparation of strategic transactions in close coordination with the CFO
Manage and further develop management, investor and partner reporting based on reliable and auditable data and processes
Coordinate interfaces with Finance Administration, Accounting, Tax, Audit, Legal and other external finance partners
Further develop finance, reporting and governance structures, as well as the systems and processes supporting them

Your profile

At least seven years of relevant professional experience in finance, including several years in a strategically responsible finance role – ideally combining experience in a demanding consulting or Big Four environment with hands-on experience in a startup, scale-up or growth company
Experience building scalable finance structures and working with integrated financial planning, business planning, financial modelling, forecasting and management reporting
Strong knowledge of controlling, business performance management, governance, risk management and the evaluation of business models, investments and growth options
Understanding of German commercial, tax and corporate law requirements, as well as experience managing external professional advisors
Ideally, experience in the media, entertainment, sports rights, streaming, subscription or digital B2C environment, including licensing and revenue-share models
Experience with financing processes, investor reporting, due diligence or M&A is an advantage
Ability to structure complex financial topics clearly and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CFO, executive team and functional departments
Strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, a high degree of independence and a strong sense of ownership
Confident and practical use of AI tools in finance; you can demonstrate with specific examples which AI-supported solutions you have implemented and what additional value they created
Excellent written and spoken German and English, as well as confident use of finance, reporting and collaboration tools

Why us?

You will shape the financial foundations of the next growth phase of an internationally active media and technology company.
You will work closely with our CFO in New York and the executive team and have a direct strategic influence.
You will have significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to build structures and systems that create lasting value.

description_clean: We are Metrify Smart Metering, Germany’s largest competitive smart metering operator, and a new strategic spin-off initiative by Enpal.Are you ready for one of the great infrastructure challenges of the 2100s? To truly transform into a decentralized power grid that can support a fully electrified, renewable future, millions of homes need to be equipped with smart meters and control systems. That’s why we are performing the fastest smart meter roll-out in the German market at unprecedented scale, shaping the way this digitally transformed grid will operate. title: Product Specialist
description_clean: Become the person who knows Cosuno best, and the one our customers want in the room.YOUR MISSIONCosuno is the platform where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, compare the offers and award the contracts. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.Our customers run complex procurement processes on Cosuno, and our commercial teams need someone who knows the product in every detail. As our Product Specialist, you'll be that person. You'll know how every workflow behaves, which workarounds exist and where the product is heading. You'll lead the customer meetings that need deep product knowledge, from custom development projects to strategic conversations with our enterprise customers. You'll report directly to our Head of Product.WHAT YOU'LL DOBe the go-to product expert. Sales, Customer Success and Account Management come to you first when a customer question goes beyond the standard. You answer all of them and turn recurring questions into answers everyone can find.Lead customer meetings. Run feedback sessions, roadmap conversations and workshops with our customers, including our largest enterprise accounts.Find solutions within the product. Sit down with customers, understand the problem behind the request and find creative ways to solve it with what we already have.Turn feedback into decisions. Back customer requests with usage data, check them against our product principles and give our PMs clear, prioritized input. When we won't build something, you explain to the customer why.Run custom developments. Project-manage custom developments for important customers: agree on scope, coordinate with Product and Engineering and deliver on time.Support demos. Join Sales in complex demos and present our roadmap and product decisions to customers and prospects.HOW WE WORKClose to the customer. We're very close to our customers and talk to them every week.Evidence over opinions. We decide what to build based on customer evidence and usage data, not on who asks loudest.AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day.WHAT YOU BRING2–4 years in a customer-facing product role in B2B SaaS, e.g. as Product Specialist, Solutions Consultant, Customer Success Manager or Implementation ManagerYou learn a complex product in depth, fast, and explain it clearly to people with very different backgroundsYou're confident in front of customers: you lead a meeting, handle tough questions and can say no with good reasonsYou've managed projects with external stakeholders, including scope, timelines and expectationsYou turn scattered customer feedback into clear, prioritized input, and you pull usage data yourself to back it upYou use AI tools every day in your own workGerman at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our product and engineering team in EnglishBonus points for experience in construction, construction tech or procurement, or with product enablement (help centre, webinars, product tours).WHY US?Real impact: You work directly with our Head of Product and shape what we build, based on what you hear from customers.Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Air.A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.ABOUT USCosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description_clean:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description
We are looking for an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to design, build, and operate the identity platforms that secure access to our applications, infrastructure, and data. You will own the technical direction of our IAM ecosystem, including authentication, authorization, lifecycle management, and privileged access. You will work with security, IT, engineering, and compliance teams to deliver a secure, scalable, and user-friendly access experience aligned with Zero Trust principles.What you will do


Design, implement, and maintain enterprise IAM solutions, including SSO, MFA, federation, and directory services.


Architect and manage identity lifecycle processes (joiner/mover/leaver), automating provisioning and deprovisioning across SaaS, cloud, and on-prem systems.


Implement and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including vaulting, session management, and just-in-time access.


Lead Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) initiatives such as access reviews, certifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and segregation-of-duties controls.


Integrate applications with the identity platform using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and LDAP.


Develop automation and tooling (APIs, scripts, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code) to reduce manual identity operations.


Secure cloud identity and access across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, including IAM policies, workload identity, and service accounts.


Define and enforce authentication and authorization standards, policies, and best practices.


Monitor identity-related threats and support detection and response for account compromise, credential abuse, and privilege escalation.


Experience and qualifications


6 to 15 years of experience in IAM, security engineering, or a related field.


Hands-on experience with at least one major IAM platform such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Ping Identity, ForgeRock, SailPoint, or CyberArk.


Strong knowledge of identity protocols and standards: SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos.


Experience with Active Directory and directory services architecture.


Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, PowerShell, Go, Java, or JavaScript).


Solid understanding of cloud IAM models (AWS IAM, Azure RBAC, GCP IAM).


Experience with MFA, passwordless, and conditional or risk-based access.


Familiarity with Zero Trust, least privilege, and defense-in-depth principles.


Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.





Additional comments
This role is based in Geneva. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
description_clean:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 
Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 
Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 
The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  
 
 About the Job
The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging.
We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role.
You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios, support atypical and beta deployments, and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities.
What you will do


Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions


Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits


Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level




Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments


Apply hotfixes when appropriate


Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers


Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers


Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design


Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact


What we're looking for


Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field


2+ years of hands-on experience working with complex systems (automation, robotics, vehicles, heavy machinery, industrial equipment, or similar)


Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills


C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems


Proficiency in Linux systems


Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments)


Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business


Driver’s license B category


Beneficial


Experience with excavators, heavy equipment, or off-road vehicles


Field testing experience


Familiarity with communication technologies such as DDS, Zenoh, LCM etc.


Experience in motion planning or control


Experience in robotic competitions


Don't meet every requirement? If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect candidate for this or other positions.

description_clean:
Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.
About the Role
You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.
We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.
The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.
It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.
What you'll be doing

Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them
Owning the trade-offs between Growth, carrier reporting, finance and actuarial: deciding what the team works on, driving alignment with key partners across other teams, and saying no when the answer is no
Making the platform scale: a new country, carrier or product should mean configuration and reused models, and recurring manual work, like carrier reporting and cash reconciliation, should turn into automation
Bringing engineering excellence to how the team works: data contracts with product teams, testing in CI, alerts that get resolved, a way to try changes before they hit production
Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

What you'll need

You've managed or led a data team before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it
Depth on one side of the data stack and working fluency on the other. You still love shipping, you review your team's work, and they trust your judgement on it
A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've turned business problems into data priorities, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed
Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results
You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt. Your team gets that from you: you try new tools and ways of working first, and bring the ones that stick

Nice to have

Experience with reporting that has to reconcile: bordereaux, revenue, cash, ledger
Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
Experience with Databricks, dbt and event tracking (Snowplow or similar)

Our stack
Databricks with Unity Catalog, dbt with SQL-based transformation, running on AWS.
None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about data, systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.
How we hire
Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:

Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.
Data Model Review. You review a change to our warehouse models with two of our engineers.
Data Platform Design. A modelling and platform problem close to what we deal with.
Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.
Meet the Founder.

You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.
 
We offer

Competitive compensation. We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants
Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days
Pension. 6% employer contribution
Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over
Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs and coaching
Central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, Friday drinks, high-spec MacBook Pro

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.
We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. Reviewing and challenging designs against real business use cases, together with your Designer.

title: Senior Product Designer
description_clean: Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it?AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice.About AIHRFounded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role.Why a designer nowWe built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market.That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind.Role and ResponsibilitiesAs our Senior Product Designer, you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster.You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set.Journeys and engagementMap and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit.Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky.Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data.Growth surfacesDesign the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels.Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from.Craft and UI ownershipYou don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence.During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent.Design system and enablementOwn our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan.Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with.How you workYou're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision.You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision.You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign.On a typical weekOn Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities. In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience.On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves.In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details.On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined.We offerA key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution;Competitive, benchmarked compensation;The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work;Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals;Flexible working hours & working from home arrangementsA high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company;A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam;26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year;Pension plan;5 Mental health days per year;Access to OpenUp mental health platform;Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read;All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;Free access to the office gym.Apply for the jobAre you excited to become our Senior Product Designer? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate.P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit.   Who you areYou're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if:You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech.You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around  you. You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas.You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion.You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence.You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard.You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same.You see feedback as a way to improve the work, hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so.You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week.Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description_clean: Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you. Why this role is excitingYou’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.Strong understanding of finance processes, ideally gained through finance transformation, operating model redesign or automation programmes.Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips.You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself.You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect.You bring finance, tech and operations along with you.Fluent in English. And unlimited paid vacation based on trust.Personal growth - You’ll grow as fast as Rohlik does. Every challenge is a chance to learn and make an impact.Real impact - What you do here matters. You’ll see your work changing how people eat and live — from day one.Recognition among colleagues - Your effort won’t go unnoticed. You can recognise others (and be recognised) through peer credits to use in our internal cafeteria.Xtra membership - You’ll get free Xtra membership and 10% cashback on everything you buy on Rohlik.cz.Sport & wellbeing - You’ll stay active with company sports challenges or a subsidised Multisport card.A team that sticks together - You’ll work with people who move fast, support each other and celebrate wins together.If this sounds like you…You’re someone who takes ownership, acts fast and gets things done. Ready to bake something great with us?Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Vice President - AI Financial Advisory (m/w/d)
description_clean: Über FintonFinton ist eine AI-Native Finance-Beratung, die AI-gestützte Lösungen für den CFO-Bereich konzipiert und implementiert. description_clean: Contexte :ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe. ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027. Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle. Sujet : « Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Renewable Energy Production and Storage in Subsurface Reservoirs”Ce poste fait partie de la subvention « Leveraging AI for Sustainable Renewable Energy Production and Storage », financée par Hi ! Paris (https://www.hi-paris.fr/). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et impactant. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.Le changement climatique exige des stratégies innovantes pour exploiter les énergies renouvelables. Le sous-sol de la Terre offre un potentiel important grâce à des technologies telles que l'énergie géothermique profonde, le stockage souterrain de l'hydrogène et le captage, l'utilisation et le stockage du carbone (CCUS). Ces méthodes pourraient transformer le paysage énergétique de la France et de l'Europe, mais elles sont souvent entravées par la sismicité induite par l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre.Pour relever ce défi, il faut des solutions avancées. La théorie du contrôle mathématique, telle qu'explorée dans le projet INJECT du CER (https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771), offre des stratégies pour minimiser les risques sismiques tout en optimisant la production d'énergie. title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Remote
description_clean: Worum es gehtMAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.Was du bei uns machstAls Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen.Deine Schwerpunkte:Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren.Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran.Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen.Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases.Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt.Was wir suchenEin herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype.Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Du gibst Verantwortung ab und freust dich, wenn das Team ohne dich gute Entscheidungen trifft. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du gern selbst weiter, denn diese Rolle ist keine reine Managementrolle.Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren.Remote führen. Du führst auch aus der Ferne wirksam. Du kommunizierst proaktiv, machst Entscheidungen schriftlich nachvollziehbar und bist für das Team gut erreichbar.Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.Klar kommunizieren. Du sprichst Probleme früh an, argumentierst mit Belegen und erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, im Team ebenso wie gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.Arbeiten bei MAIAUns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.Ein großer Teil des Teams arbeitet gemeinsam in unserem Büro in Leipzig, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kocht fast jeden Tag zusammen. Du arbeitest remote von überall in Deutschland, dein Wohnsitz muss in Deutschland liegen. Zweimal im Jahr treffen wir uns zu Team-Events, und ab und zu gibt es Teamtage in Leipzig. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding AgentsUnterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, auch zu FührungsthemenZugang zu einer Wellpass-MitgliedschaftVergütungDas Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 90.000 bis 100.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem Interview zu Technik und Führung. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.Bewerbung und nächste SchritteEin Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges Interview zu Technik und Führung und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Nos clients ont dépassé le stade du POC. Leur question porte maintenant sur l'intégration des agents au SI et au cycle de delivery, et sur ce qui doit être mutualisé dans une plateforme plutôt que laissé à chaque équipe. Ce sont des questions d'architecture, et on n'a personne dont c'est le métier à plein temps.
Tes missions 🎯

•    intervenir en avant-vente comme garant technique, challenger les demandes et aider le client à transformer un problème flou en décision

Passer à l'échelle avec les coding agents
Le cas du début. Tu analyses l'existant, tu identifies les capacités manquantes et tu conçois l'architecture qui permet aux équipes et aux agents de travailler ensemble de façon observable et sécurisée. Le vrai sujet est souvent le knowledge : reconstruire un contexte exploitable à partir de repos, de docs et de conventions que personne n'a maintenus depuis trois ans.
Décider ce qui se mutualise
Cinq équipes expérimentent chacune avec leurs propres modèles, agents et outils. Tu aides le client à trancher ce qui remonte dans une plateforme, ce qui reste décentralisé et dans quel ordre y aller. La réponse est rarement la grande plateforme IA. C'est plus souvent trois capacités bien choisies qui débloquent tout le monde.
Avec qui tu travailles 🤝

Chez nos clients : CTO, responsables Engineering, architectes, Platform Engineers, développeurs, équipes sécurité et Product. Tu dois pouvoir passer d'une discussion d'architecture très technique à une décision avec un dirigeant dans la même journée.


 
Chez Thiga : nos Product Builders, Product Engineers et consultants Product. Ton rôle est de construire les enablers technologiques qui leur permettent de tirer parti de l'IA sur leurs missions, et de les faire progresser.

Ton profil 🚀
Une culture Tech large
Tu es d'abord un bon technologue. Tu as assez de kilomètres au compteur, souvent une dizaine d'années, pour avoir vu des architectures évoluer, atteindre leurs limites et parfois échouer.
Une vraie profondeur IA
Tu comprends les systèmes construits avec des LLM et des agents, ce qu'ils permettent et où ils coincent. Context engineering, retrieval, tool use, systèmes agentiques, evals, sécurité, observabilité : tu sais raisonner sur les propriétés architecturales que ces systèmes introduisent et sur ce qu'elles impliquent pour le reste du SI.

Tu cherches à comprendre le problème, les utilisateurs, les contraintes de l'organisation et le résultat attendu avant de dessiner une solution. Tu sais challenger un client, poser plusieurs options avec leurs compromis, puis l'aider à décider.

Thiga vient du Product Management, ce qui change la manière d'aborder l'AI-Native SDLC. Cette transformation touche la technologie, le produit et la façon dont les équipes travaillent en même temps, donc on refuse de la traiter comme un simple sujet d'outillage ou de plateforme.

title: Senior Requirements Engineer Digital Product, 80-100%
description_clean:

Aufgaben
Das bewegst du

Du verantwortest das fachliche Herz unseres Produkts: das Domänenmodell. Capabilities, Business Objects, Business Rules und Prozesse hältst du korrekt, widerspruchsfrei und aktuell. Und du sorgst dafür, dass sie über Domänen hinweg zusammenpassen. 
Aus vielschichtigen, oft widersprüchlichen Anforderungen machst du klare Struktur: Nachvollziehbare Use Cases, scharf geschnittene Anforderungen und eindeutige Akzeptanzkriterien. Dein wichtigster Beitrag ist dabei nicht, jeden Einzelwunsch zu spezifizieren. Es ist zu erkennen, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und die allgemeine Lösung durchzusetzen. 
Du präzisierst Produktentscheide für die Umsetzung: Regeln, Grenzfälle, Zustände und Sollverhalten. Bei komplexen und domänenübergreifenden Themen führst du die Spezifikation selbst. Im Übrigen setzt du den Standard, nach dem im Team spezifiziert wird, und entwickelst die Modellierungskompetenz deiner Kolleg:innen weiter. 
Qualität ist für dich Teil der Spezifikationsarbeit und kein nachgelagerter Schritt. Du erstellst E2E-Testkonzepte und Testfälle für deinen Bereich und prüfst Features. Wir sind ein kleines Team, in dem alle die Qualität des Produkts mittragen. 
Du bist für die von dir verantworteten Features die fachliche Ansprechperson für Engineering, Design, Customer Success und Sales sowie für Partner, Reseller und Kunden. Du bist auch die Person, die „so geht das fachlich nicht“ sagen kann und dafür gehört wird. 
Deine Arbeit startet in der Product Discovery: Bei der Problemrahmung, nicht erst bei der Übersetzung fertiger Entscheide. Zudem bringst du deine fachliche Sicht in Architekturentscheide ein, wo sie Konsequenzen für das Domänenmodell haben. 
PEAX baut gerade agentische Architekturen. Du nutzt AI-Tools strukturiert und verantwortungsvoll als Bestandteil unseres Requirement Engineering Prozesses.

Qualifikation

Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung als Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im B2B-SaaS-Produktumfeld, idealerweise in einer Scale-up-Phase und mit Hintergrund in Document Management, ECM, Workflow-Automatisierung oder einem verwandten Information-Hub-Umfeld. Du hast dabei nachweisbar Verantwortung für fachliche Modelle getragen und nicht nur für Spezifikationsdokumente. 
Ausbildungshintergrund in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Business Engineering, BWL mit IT-Affinität (FH, Universität). MSc-Niveau ideal, Bachelor mit entsprechender Senior-Erfahrung ebenfalls möglich.

title: Senior contractmanager (domein IT)
description_clean: Wil jij ervoor zorgen dat belangrijke contracten niet alleen goed zijn afgesloten, maar gedurende de hele looptijd ook daadwerkelijk waarde leveren? En krijg jij energie van leveranciers uitdagen, risico’s beheersen en samen met de business sturen op prestaties en verbetering? Kies dan voor Univé!Wie zijn wij?Het mooie van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de resultaten, de geschiedenis, de cultuur, het ontstaan en de betrokkenheid. Dat is samenwerken. Een coöperatie zijn zonder winstoogmerk. Dicht bij onze leden staan. En samen bouwen aan een organisatie die betrouwbaar, toekomstbestendig en wendbaar is.Wij richten ons op het voorkomen van risico’s, het beperken van gevolgen en we verzekeren alleen als het echt nodig is. Coöperatie Univé bestaat uit zeven verschillende Regionale Univé’s, zodat we op landelijk én lokaal niveau altijd dichtbij onze leden zijn. Dat is het mooie van Univé.Waar kom je te werken?Je komt te werken binnen de afdeling Inkoop & Facilitaire Zaken, in het team Inkoop & Contractmanagement. Dit team voert binnen Univé de regie op inkoop-, contract- en leveranciersmanagement. Ons doel? Grip op uitgaven en risico’s, professionele en efficiënte processen én optimale ondersteuning van de business.We zijn volop in ontwikkeling. Inkoop & Contractmanagement groeit verder naar een professionele, businessgerichte en datagedreven regiepartner. Dat betekent dat we niet alleen kijken naar wat er contractueel is afgesproken, maar vooral ook naar de waarde die contracten en leveranciers gedurende de looptijd daadwerkelijk voor Univé realiseren.Als contractmanager speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol. Je werkt intensief samen met contracteigenaren, management, inkopers, Risk, Compliance en Juridische Zaken. En natuurlijk met onze leveranciers.Jouw uitdagingAls contractmanager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren en bewaken van contractwaarde gedurende de volledige looptijd van onze contracten.Je voert regie op het contract- en leveranciersmanagement van de aan jou toegewezen contracten en leveranciers. Daarbij stuur je op naleving van afspraken, kosten, kwaliteit, risico’s, performance, compliance en duurzaamheid.Je zorgt ervoor dat Univé grip houdt op de ingekochte dienstverlening en dat afspraken niet alleen op papier goed geregeld zijn, maar in de praktijk ook worden nagekomen.Daarbij ben je een stevige gesprekspartner voor zowel de business als leveranciers. Je organiseert en leidt leveranciersoverleggen, maakt prestaties en risico’s inzichtelijk en zorgt dat acties daadwerkelijk worden opgevolgd. Zie je afwijkingen, kansen of risico’s? Dan wacht je niet af, maar kom je in actie.Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:regie voeren op complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten;sturen op contractnaleving, kosten, kwaliteit, performance, risico’s, compliance en duurzaamheid;organiseren en leiden van leveranciersoverleggen;bewaken van SLA’s, KPI’s, afspraken en verbetermaatregelen;begeleiden van wijzigingen, indexaties, evaluaties, verlengingen en beëindigingen;signaleren en beheersen van contractuele, leveranciers- en continuïteitsrisico’s;initiëren en begeleiden van verbeterplannen, disputen en escalaties;ondersteunen van contracteigenaren en management bij besluitvorming over contracten en leveranciers;opstellen van analyses en managementrapportages over contractstatus, prestaties, risico’s, acties en besluitpunten;tijdig signaleren wanneer hercontractering of een nieuwe marktbenadering nodig is;bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé.De inhoudelijke beoordeling van de dienstverlening ligt primair bij de business en contracteigenaar. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze prestaties periodiek worden beoordeeld en voert regie op de contractuele borging, opvolging en eventuele escalatie. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan één overleg of één contractmoment. Wie ben jij?Je bent een contractmanager die regie pakt. title: Senior Systems Engineer
description_clean:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Systems Engineer to our team in Munich Germany. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased array antennas and radios for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. 


The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, experience in space technology, and the ability to be the technical point of contact for our communication programs. In this position, you will lead the development of communication system architectures, operational concepts, requirements, and system-level performance analysis for advanced communication terminals and networks. You will coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and drive complex programs to success.

incidents/complaints, and safeguards to minimise conduct risk).Privacy and Security In close coordination with our DPO (Léa) and security stakeholders, you ensure that our Financial Services operating title: AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time)
description_clean:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in France.
In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy.
Accountabilities

Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts.
AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations.
Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors.
Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures.
Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs.
Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth.
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch.
Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives.
E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions.
Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment.
Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts.

Requirements

Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition.
Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms.
Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions.
Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products.
Relevant portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating high-quality interior visuals, AI-generated imagery, product concepts, home décor projects, or other closely related creative work.
Project management and organization: Strong organizational skills, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple creative assignments while meeting deadlines.
English proficiency: Fluent English communication skills for collaborating with the team, discussing concepts, understanding feedback, and documenting creative decisions.
Commercial awareness: An understanding of how visual design, product differentiation, and customer preferences influence purchasing decisions in e-commerce.

Strongly preferred:

Professional experience in home décor, interior styling, furniture, or lifestyle products.
Experience developing concepts for physical products from initial inspiration through visual refinement.
Familiarity with US interior design trends, home décor preferences, and target customer expectations.
Experience producing product photography alternatives, lifestyle visuals, or marketing imagery for e-commerce websites.
Knowledge of wood, natural finishes, and other materials commonly used in premium home décor.

Nice to have:

Experience collaborating with manufacturers, product designers, or suppliers.
Understanding of product feasibility, manufacturing processes, production constraints, and shipping considerations.
Experience using Pinterest, Instagram, or similar platforms to research interior design inspiration, consumer trends, and emerging product opportunities.
Familiarity with iterative creative workflows that combine AI-generated concepts with product development and commercial evaluation.

Important role clarification: This position focuses on AI-assisted product concept development, interior styling, and photorealistic visual creation. It is not a traditional CAD design or UX/UI design role. The ideal candidate combines outstanding visual judgment with the ability to create attractive, realistic, and commercially viable home décor concepts using generative AI.
Benefits

Competitive compensation: US$25–$45 per hour, depending on experience, skills, and portfolio quality.
Flexible engagement: Choose between part-time and full-time collaboration, with an expected workload of approximately 25 hours per week.
100% remote work: Work remotely from Anywhere.
Long-term opportunity: Initial 12-month contract with an emphasis on sustained collaboration and continued product development.
Freelance flexibility: Independent contractor engagement, offering flexibility in organizing your work and managing creative projects.
Creative ownership: Contribute directly to product concepts, interior styling, and visual assets that support commercial launches.
AI-driven innovation: Work with modern generative AI tools to explore new creative workflows and develop innovative product imagery.
Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with designers and other team members to refine concepts and bring new home décor products to market.
Portfolio development: Build experience creating AI-powered product concepts and high-quality lifestyle visuals for a premium direct-to-consumer e-commerce business.

Application requirements:
Please include the following when applying:

Your portfolio featuring relevant interior visuals, product concepts, AI-generated images, or home décor projects.
A list of the AI image-generation tools you regularly use.
Your expected hourly rate.
Your availability and preferred working arrangement (part-time or full-time).

Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.

About This Role:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain.
This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.
We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:
At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:
In this role, you will:

Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.


 Your Profile:

5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.

As a Data Scientist Intern, you will help us push the boundaries of what AI can do inside Pigment, focusing on how our AI Modeler builds and maintains planning models. Project Overview: Making Pigment’s AI Modeler Smarter
Depending on your profile and interests, you will focus on one of these topics:
1. Formula Writing from Specifications
Have the Modeler write a specification of a formula (what it should do, and the tests it must pass), then build a small Formula Writer model that produces a correct formula from it.
2. Building Models from External Documents
Turn amorphous inputs (long PDFs, call transcripts, existing applications, templates) into structured Pigment applications: write the tests first, then iterate on a DSL representation until they pass.
3. Building Models from Databases
Given an existing database, determine which blocks and transformations to create to make sense of the data and integrate it as a Pigment model.
As an intern, you will:

Define success criteria, test suites, and evaluation metrics for your topic.
Design and iterate on LLM-based approaches (prompting, agentic workflows, intermediate representations).

Work with engineers and data scientists to build evaluation pipelines and share findings.

Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement.

Objectif : renforcer la confiance des praticiens et faire entrer Vidal dans l’ère du service médical “fonctionnel”.

 
Parmi les technos les plus représentées sur nos projets, tu pourras être amené à travailler avec : Java (Spring Boot), Angular, Node (Nest), React (Next), Python…

Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras :

Devenir un expert en développement en étant formé aux meilleurs standards de qualité
Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique
Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…)
Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, évangéliste (spécialiste d’un sujet), CTO ou fondateur d’une entité etc

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.
 
Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Tu es promoteur de l’IA, notamment sur les sujets de GenAI, et tu cherches à progresser en continu grâce à la veille technique

description_clean:
L’histoire de Theodo et son succès
Depuis 2009, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Notre approche : le meilleur de la technologie, au service de la création de valeur, porté par l'approche Lean.
Notre approche unique est fondée sur 3 principes :

nous avons développé des expertises reconnues dans les technologies clés de la conception et du développement produit;
quelle que soit l’étape du projet, notre priorité à chaque décision est la création de valeur pour nos clients;
nous recrutons les meilleurs talents digitaux et cultivons leur ingéniosité grâce à l’approche lean.

En 15 ans, nous sommes devenus un groupe de plus de 700 Theodoers, organisé en entités spécialisées par technologie (Apps, Cloud, Data & AI) et par industrie (Fintech, Govtech, Healthtech, Consumer Products Goods). En 2025, le groupe génère 100M€ de CA.
Tes missions
La santé se digitalise. Les données de vie réelle explosent. Elles facilitent le soin et accélèrent la recherche, notamment via les entrepôts de données de santé.
Ces données sont extrêmement sensibles et réglementées. Nos clients ont donc besoin de notre expertise pour bâtir des applications sur des architectures Cloud conformes à la réglementation HDS. L'arrivée des LLM ajoute un défi : exposer ces données à des agents pour aider les soignants et les patients, sans jamais transiger sur la sécurité.
Dans notre équipe, tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au service du soin et de la recherche. Des projets utiles, pour des produits qui comptent.
Ton rôle : concevoir, convaincre et déployer
Ta mission est avant tout opérationnelle. Tu conçois, tu présentes et tu mets en place des architectures Cloud qui répondent aux besoins fonctionnels, de sécurité et de conformité de nos clients.
Concrètement :

Avant-vente : traduire un besoin en architecture adaptée, et convaincre le client que c’est la plus ingénieuse pour le projet.
Déploiement : infrastructure as code, de bout en bout.
Audit : conformité HDS et bonnes pratiques des standards Cloud.
Développement d’assets : agents, boilerplates, projets open source.

À plus long terme, nous voulons t’impliquer dans la structuration des offres et des équipes Theodo.
Autonome sur ton expertise, fort en équipe
Sur l'architecture Cloud, tu dois pouvoir être autonome. C'est ton domaine, tu le pilotes.
Mais tu ne travailles jamais seul. En avant-vente, tu fais équipe avec l'Account Manager et le Solution Architect. En projet, tu collabores avec l'Engineering Manager et les autres DevOps. La collaboration est au centre de chaque mission.
 
L'équipe que tu rejoins
Theodo est certifié infogéreur HDS. Nous avons développé notre propre framework de mise en conformité, et assurons la maintenance HDS d'une vingtaine d'applications en production.

Ton manager : Ludovic Descateaux, Group Manager de Theodo Healthtech.
En avant-vente : un binôme Account Manager (ex. Marine Accolas) et Solution Architect.
En projet : un Engineering Manager (ex. Thomas Walter).
L'équipe Run HDS, riche de plus de 50 projets, t'épaule sur les architectures.
Tu participes aux guildes Sécu, DevOps, Agentique, et aux rituels hebdomadaires de formation.

Tes perspectives d'évolution (moyen / long terme)

Business : Partnership, avec la responsabilité d'une plateforme business et/ou d'une practice du groupe.
Managériale : Group Manager.

 
Profil recherché
Expériences

6 à 14 ans d'expérience.

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description_clean:
About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.
That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.
You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.
What you'll be doing

Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc.
Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market.
Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan.
Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets.
Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches.
Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements.
Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions.

Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.
Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting.
A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience.
Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change.
Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus.
An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change.
The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global.
A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction.
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
