Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
Présentation de Theodo
Avec ses clients, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Le groupe accompagne les entreprises dans leurs transformations digitales en mobilisant des expertises complémentaires en Design, Web, Mobile, Data & IA, Cloud et Serverless.
Grâce à ses différentes entités expertes et sectorielles, Theodo aide ses clients à concevoir des produits innovants, à accélérer leur développement et à répondre à leurs enjeux stratégiques et opérationnels.
Dans un environnement technologique en constante évolution, Theodo s’appuie sur une forte culture entrepreneuriale, une approche orientée résultats et une exigence élevée en matière de qualité et de satisfaction client.
Contexte du recrutement
Dans un contexte de développement et de transformation continue, Theodo France doit poursuivre sa croissance, renforcer son excellence opérationnelle et assurer l’alignement entre ses ambitions stratégiques et leur mise en œuvre au quotidien.
Pour accompagner Noémie Parker dans le pilotage de ses priorités et le développement de Theodo France, nous recherchons un(e) Chief of Staff, véritable bras droit, capable de faire le lien entre la vision stratégique, les décisions de la direction et leur exécution opérationnelle.
Au plus près des enjeux de l’entreprise, tu travailleras sur des sujets transverses à fort impact, en interaction avec les équipes de direction et les responsables opérationnels. Ton rôle sera de fluidifier la prise de décision, de structurer les initiatives prioritaires et de garantir leur bonne exécution.
Tes missions
Ton objectif : démultiplier l’impact de Noémie Parker et contribuer directement à la performance de Theodo France, en apportant un appui stratégique et opérationnel, tout en garantissant la bonne coordination des parties prenantes.
1. Contribuer à la définition et au déploiement de la stratégie


Participer à la définition des priorités stratégiques de Theodo France à 12 mois, en lien avec Noémie Parker et les équipes de direction.


Analyser les leviers de croissance, les enjeux de performance et les opportunités de développement.


Préparer les revues stratégiques et contribuer à la formalisation des plans d’action.


Transformer les orientations stratégiques en objectifs clairs, mesurables et partagés par les équipes.


2. Accompagner la direction dans le pilotage opérationnel


Préparer et animer les réunions de direction : définition de l’ordre du jour, priorisation des sujets, suivi des décisions et des actions.


Structurer les processus de prise de décision et assurer le suivi des priorités.


Anticiper les points de blocage et faciliter la résolution des sujets transverses.


Organiser les temps forts de la direction : séminaires stratégiques, réunions d’équipe et moments de réflexion collective.


Préparer les supports de communication permettant de partager la vision, les priorités et les résultats avec l’ensemble des équipes.


3. Piloter les chantiers stratégiques et transverses


Identifier et structurer les projets prioritaires pour le développement de Theodo France.


Définir les objectifs, les indicateurs de suivi, les responsabilités et les échéances de chaque chantier.


Coordonner les parties prenantes et accompagner les responsables de projets dans leur exécution.


Suivre l’avancement des initiatives, identifier les risques et proposer des plans d’action correctifs.


Veiller à ce que les décisions prises par la direction se traduisent concrètement en résultats.


4. Contribuer à la performance et à l’excellence opérationnelle


Analyser les indicateurs clés de performance de l’activité et identifier les axes d’amélioration.


Préparer des analyses et recommandations pour éclairer les décisions de la direction.


Accompagner la mise en place de nouveaux processus et outils visant à améliorer l’efficacité collective.


Piloter des projets transverses à l’échelle de Theodo France, selon les priorités identifiées par la direction.


Faciliter la collaboration entre les différentes équipes et entités pour accélérer l’exécution des projets.


Tes perspectives
En devenant Chief of Staff, tu seras au cœur des décisions et des enjeux de développement de Theodo France.
Tu développeras une compréhension approfondie du fonctionnement d’une entreprise technologique, de la définition de sa stratégie à son exécution opérationnelle. Tu travailleras directement avec la direction sur des problématiques variées, avec un niveau d’exposition élevé et une forte autonomie.
Ce poste te permettra de développer des compétences solides en stratégie, en pilotage de la performance, en gestion de projets complexes et en leadership transverse.
À terme, cette expérience pourra ouvrir la voie à des fonctions de direction opérationnelle, de direction de business unit ou à d’autres rôles de leadership au sein d’un environnement entrepreneurial.
Profil recherché


Tu disposes de 3 à 6 ans d’expérience, idéalement avec une expérience significative en conseil en stratégie, en organisation ou en transformation.


Tu possèdes un excellent esprit analytique et sais structurer des problématiques complexes pour en tirer des recommandations concrètes.


Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et capable de gérer plusieurs sujets simultanément, sans perdre de vue les priorités.


Tu es un(e) véritable doer : tu sais passer de la réflexion à l’action et obtenir des résultats concrets.


Tu disposes d’un excellent relationnel et sais interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment des membres de la direction.


Tu es à l’aise pour challenger les idées, formuler des recommandations et faire avancer les décisions.


Tu fais preuve d’autonomie, de proactivité et d’un fort sens des responsabilités.


Tu apprécies les environnements exigeants, dynamiques et entrepreneuriaux, dans lesquels les priorités peuvent évoluer rapidement.


Ce qui fera la différence : ta capacité à combiner hauteur de vue stratégique, rigueur d’exécution et intelligence relationnelle pour transformer les ambitions de Theodo France en résultats tangibles.

description_clean:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.Ton équipe :
Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 120 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.
 
Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.
 

La practice AI Modernisation est l’offre prioritaire du Groupe et porte la vision de Theodo de devenir le leader européen de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel. Notre métier, c’est la migration accélérée par IA de vieux systèmes de legacy vers des langages et framework plus modernes pour réduire les risques business, cybersécurité, de compliance que ces systèmes peuvent présenter. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques.
Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit.

 
Tes futures missions :
En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo, ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.
 
Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement.
 
Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo :

Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement.
Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée.
Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement.
Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements

 
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :


HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.


Tes perspectives d'évolution :
Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras :

Devenir un expert en développement en étant formé aux meilleurs standards de qualité
Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique
Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…)
Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, évangéliste (spécialiste d’un sujet), CTO ou fondateur d’une entité etc

 
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.
 
Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.
 
Profil recherché :
Nous recherchons avant tout des potentiels plus que des compétences déjà acquises. Si tu n’es pas encore un·e développeur·se chevronné·e, ce n’est pas un frein : ne te retiens pas pour postuler.

title: Accountant (all genders)
description_clean:

Du möchtest als zentrale IT Ansprechperson die technische Infrastruktur eines Unternehmens gestalten, weiterentwickeln und automatisieren? 
Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. 
Unser Kunde ist ein dynamisch wachsendes E Commerce Unternehmen in Berlin, das mit tausenden Produkten in verschiedenen Kategorien erfolgreich auf digitalen Marktplätzen agiert. Als einer der führenden Händler auf Amazon in Deutschland verbindet das Unternehmen datengetriebene Prozesse mit einem modernen Technologieansatz. 
Für die interne IT wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit gesucht, die als fachlich führende IT Person die Microsoft Umgebung verantwortet, technologische Standards setzt und gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen Geschäftsprozesse automatisiert.
Aufgaben
Als fachlich führende IT Person verantwortest du die gesamte interne IT Umgebung. Da die Infrastruktur bewusst schlank gehalten ist und der Support überschaubar bleibt, liegt dein Fokus vor allem auf Architektur, Sicherheit, Automatisierung und der Weiterentwicklung der IT. 

Microsoft 365: Vollständige Administration und Weiterentwicklung von Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint und Teams einschließlich Conditional Access und Geräte Compliance. 
Azure: Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Azure Umgebung mit Fokus auf virtuelle Maschinen, Netzwerk, Backup und Kostenoptimierung. 
Netzwerk & Security: Verantwortung für Netzwerk, Sophos Firewall und VPN sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen und sicheren Betriebs. 
Automatisierung: Konzeption und Umsetzung von Geschäftsprozess Automatisierungen mit Power Automate und PowerShell in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen. 
Technologie & Standards: Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter Technologien, Definition technischer Standards sowie strukturierte Dokumentation der IT Umgebung. 
IT Projekte: Eigenständige Steuerung von IT Projekten sowie Koordination und fachliche Steuerung externer Dienstleister bei Bedarf. 
3rd Level Support: Fachliche Unterstützung der Junior Kollegin, die den 1st und 2nd Level Support übernimmt, sowie Übernahme komplexer technischer Fragestellungen im 3rd Level. 
Wissensaufbau: Fachliche Weiterentwicklung der Junior Kollegin sowie Vermittlung von Wissen und Best Practices innerhalb des Unternehmens. 
KI & Digitalisierung: Weiterentwicklung des strukturellen Einsatzes von KI Lösungen und Automatisierungstechnologien zur Optimierung interner Prozesse. 
Prozessoptimierung: Analyse bestehender Geschäftsprozesse, Identifikation von Digitalisierungspotenzialen und Entwicklung nachhaltiger technischer Lösungen.

Qualifikation

Rund 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Systemadministration oder als Systems Engineer. 
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Entra ID, Intune und der Microsoft 365 Administration, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, dieses Wissen weiterzugeben. 
Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, insbesondere mit virtuellen Maschinen, Netzwerken und Backups. 
Erfahrung mit Netzwerken und Firewalls, idealerweise mit Sophos. 
Sicherer Umgang mit PowerShell im Arbeitsalltag. 
Erfahrung mit Power Automate oder die klare Bereitschaft, sich in diesem Bereich weiterzuentwickeln. 
Ausgeprägtes Prozessverständnis und der Anspruch, Prozesse zunächst zu verstehen und anschließend sinnvoll zu automatisieren. 
Eigenständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein. 
Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und Kolleginnen und Kollegen fachlich zu unterstützen. 
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gutes technisches Englisch.

Benefits

Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.  
Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr.      
Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen.  
Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet.  
Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg.  
Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro.  
Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander.  
Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung.  
Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits.

title: Staff Security Engineer
description_clean:
Build security platforms, not security processes
We are looking for a Staff Security Engineer to strengthen the security of our products, data and engineering platform.
This is a highly technical and hands-on role. You will work closely with Engineering teams to continuously harden our systems while helping design the next generation of our security architecture.
You will operate across two horizons:


Strengthen security today: continuously harden our applications, access controls and data-protection mechanisms against evolving threats.


Build the privacy architecture of tomorrow: move beyond traditional perimeter and access-control security by designing systems where sensitive data is cryptographically isolated, minimally exposed, and increasingly usable without being directly revealed.


The ultimate objective is not simply to make Swile harder to breach. It is to make a breach increasingly uninteresting, because there is less usable data available to steal.What you will do
We want Security Engineering to create capabilities that scale across hundreds of engineers.
You will:


Identify and reduce high-impact security risks across our applications, APIs and internal tools.


Strengthen authentication, authorization and access controls.


Improve the protection of sensitive and personal data.


Design controls that limit the blast radius of compromised accounts, services or infrastructure.


Improve security monitoring, auditability and detection of suspicious access patterns.


Perform threat modelling and targeted security reviews.


Build reusable security capabilities directly into our engineering platform and development lifecycle.


Contribute to long-term architectures around data isolation, encryption, tokenisation and privacy-preserving systems.


Partner with engineering teams to address systemic security risks rather than individual findings.


Where possible, a security requirement should become code rather than documentation.
What we are looking forYou are first and foremost a strong engineer.
You have significant experience building or securing production software and distributed systems. You are comfortable reading and writing production code, designing systems and working directly with Engineering teams.
You have deep security engineering expertise and strong experience in several of the following areas:


Application and Product Security


API Security


IAM, authentication and authorization


OAuth2 / OIDC, WebAuthn / FIDO2


RBAC / ABAC and privilege management


Cloud security


Cryptography, KMS / HSM and envelope encryption


Tokenisation and secrets management


Data Security and Privacy Engineering


Threat modelling and secure software architecture


Security monitoring and detection


Stronger attacker mindset
You naturally ask:


What happens if this employee becomes malicious?


What happens if this backend is compromised?


What happens if someone dumps this database?


Can this endpoint be called directly?


How much data can one account access before we notice?


Where else does this information get replicated?


Why do we have this data at all?


You think in terms of attack paths, blast radius and least privilege, not just compliance requirements.
Pragmatism
You know that security engineering is a prioritisation problem.
You can distinguish between:


something that needs to be fixed this week;


something that requires an architectural redesign;


something cryptographically elegant but operationally unnecessary.


You are comfortable deploying simple, high-impact controls quickly while designing stronger long-term foundations.
What would make you stand out
Experience with:


large-scale SaaS or fintech platforms;


highly sensitive or regulated data;


multi-tenant architectures;


insider risk or data-loss prevention;


advanced cryptographic or privacy-enhancing technologies.


What success looks like


Sensitive data is exposed to fewer systems and people.


Access to sensitive resources is increasingly scoped, attributable and auditable.


Compromising a single account or service has a limited blast radius.


Security controls are increasingly enforced by the platform rather than by process.


Product teams can build secure systems faster and with less friction.


What this role is not
This is not primarily a GRC, SOC, compliance, policy-writing or penetration-testing role.
Those disciplines are important, but this role exists to change how our products and systems are engineered.
We expect this person to design systems, write code, influence architecture and ship security capabilities into production.Localization of this positionThis position can be based at our offices in Paris, Toulouse, or Montpellier on a flex-remote basis.Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

And beyond.We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.Here is how your key outcomes will look like:Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).Transport. Alan est né pour changer ça — en combinant assurance santé et clinique virtuelle dans une seule application pour devenir un vrai partenaire santé.La Clinique Alan réunit plus de 120 professionnels de santé disponibles 7j/7 : médecins généralistes, sages-femmes, psychologues, kinésithérapeutes, dermatologues, pédiatres, nutritionnistes, infirmières puéricultrices.Nos membres bénéficient d'une prise en charge véritablement intégrée :🩺 Téléconsultation vidéo : pour les situations qui nécessitent une consultation médicale en direct💬 Chat médical : conseils de professionnels de santé, 7j/7, réponse en moins de 30 minutes🤖 Mo, notre compagnon santé IA : répond instantanément aux questions du quotidien, avec des réponses relues et validées par nos médecins🎯 Des programmes de prévention (mal de dos, gestion du stress) : guidés et personnalisés🧘 Alan Play : une approche ludique de la prévention autour de l'activité physique, du bien-être mental et de la cohésion d'équipe🩸 Qu’est-ce qu’Alan Précision ?Il s’agit de notre tout nouveau programme de prévention ; un service de santé préventive avancée, à la croisée de la médecine de précision, de la biologie et du mode de vie.Le constat : en France, il y a environ 12 ans d’écart entre l’espérance de vie et l’espérance de vie en bonne santé, et plus de la moitié des maladies chroniques sont évitables. Plutôt que d’attendre les symptômes, nous repérons les signaux biologiques précoces et nous les traduisons en actions concrètes.Le service repose sur trois briques :💉 Un bilan sanguin de plus de 80 biomarqueurs et ratios, réalisé dans plus de 300 laboratoires partenaires. Il couvre le cardiovasculaire (ApoB, Lp(a)…), le métabolisme (insuline, HOMA-IR, HbA1c), le foie, le rein, la thyroïde, l’inflammation (hs-CRP), les micronutriments et les hormones.💬 Un questionnaire d’environ 200 questions sur le mode de vie, les objectifs et les antécédents.🎯 Un rapport personnalisé généré par IA et validé par nos médecins, qui contient l’analyse de chaque biomarqueur en contexte, un Score de Santé, un Âge Biologique, des recommandations sur le mode de vie et un plan d’action avec 3-5 objectifs prioritaires basés sur les grands “piliers” de la prévention (activité physique, nutrition, santé mentale, sommeil, …).🔍 Ce que nous recherchonsNous recrutons des médecins généralistes curieux de prévention et de médecine de précision, pour rejoindre le petit groupe de médecins qui relisent et valident les rapports Alan Précision.✅ Curieux(se) de ce que l’IA peut apporter à la pratique✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients✅ Un vrai intérêt pour la thématique et l'envie d'apprendre : un DU (nutrition, prévention…) est un plus, mais pas indispensable✅ Disponible au moins 4h par semaine (horaires flexibles)✅ Statut libéral🧠 Votre rôle : le regard médical qui fait la différenceL’IA prépare, vous validez. Avant d’arriver chez le membre, chaque rapport passe entre vos mains : vous en êtes le garant médical, et c’est votre expertise qui en fait un rapport fiable et utile.Concrètement, vous :Relisez le rapport généré par l’IA et vérifier son exactitude médicaleVous vous assurez que les interprétations collent au profil de la personne (âge, sexe, activité, habitudes)Apportez la nuance que seul un médecin sait apporter :un lien de causalité trop affirmatif (« est causé par » doit devenir « peut être lié à »)une formulation anxiogèneune incohérence entre les sections du rapportune recommandation qui ne correspond pas au profilune supplémentation exotique ou mal étayéeÊtes le filet de sécurité : vous bloquez et faites remonter les situations qui sortent du cadre de la prévention (valeur critique, pathologie active suspectée, interaction médicamenteuse…)Signalez les erreurs récurrentes de l’IA : vos corrections servent directement à améliorer les rapports suivantsA noter:Vous n’écrivez pas les rapports, vous ne prescrivez pas, et vous n’échangez pas directement avec les utilisateurs. Les résultats biologiques arrivent automatiquement par MSSanté.Tout se fait en asynchrone : pas de créneau fixe, pas de patient qui attend. Vous relisez les rapports quand vous voulez — le soir, entre deux consultations, le week-end.Il s'agit donc d'une activité complémentaire idéale pour diversifier votre exercice, sans salle d’attente ni urgence. 🙌 Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ?🔬 Une thématique passionnante. Médecine de précision, biomarqueurs, prévention avancée qui associe biologie et mode de vie : une approche encore rare en France, que vous pratiquerez au quotidien. Enfin le temps de faire de la prévention approfondie, celle qu'une consultation de 15 minutes ne permet pas.🎓 Une expertise qui enrichit votre pratique. Vous développez des compétences rares (ApoB, Lp(a), insulinorésistance, micronutrition…) que vous pourrez aussi mobiliser auprès de vos propres patients.📚 Formation et partage. Onboarding et formation à la médecine de précision, sessions d'échange entre médecins, veille scientifique.🏥 Un cadre médical structuré. Vous exercez dans un cadre clair, conforme aux exigences réglementaires et déontologiques, pour des prises en charge cohérentes, harmonisées et sécurisées. Des médecins référents vous accompagnent dans les situations cliniques difficiles.🤝 Un petit groupe de pionniers. Au-delà de la mission freelance, vous rejoignez la communauté d'une dizaine de médecins qui construisent Alan Précision : partage de connaissances, échanges sur les cas, et vos retours qui orientent directement l'évolution du produit. Vous faites aussi partie de la Clinic Alan et de ses plus de 120 professionnels de santé.🤖 Co-construire l'avenir de la médecine. Quelle place pour l'IA dans le parcours de soin? Chez Alan, les médecins sont au cœur de ces réflexions et impliqués dans son développement.💰 Des conditions attractives. Nous proposons une rémunération attractive (70€/h), une grande flexibilité d’organisation (travail 100 % asynchrone et à distance) et l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une communauté médicale engagée.Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Stage Master 2 : Elaboration de panneaux biosourcés à base de pailles

title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques - CDD de 18 mois
description_clean: Qui sommes-nous ?Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en fondements quantiques et méthodes algébriques pour rejoindre le département INFRES à Télécom Paris.Le poste est accueilli au sein de Quriosity, équipe commune à Inria et Télécom Paris, au laboratoire LTCI et au département Informatique et Réseaux (INFRES). Située à Palaiseau, sur le plateau de Saclay, l’équipe bénéficie d’un environnement actif en information quantique et en fondements de la théorie quantique.Le recrutement relève du projet PIQ « Nouveaux outils algébriques pour les décompositions causales des processus quantiques », sous la responsabilité d’Augustin Vanrietvelde. Il porte sur la phase 1 du projet, pour une durée de 18 mois.Le projet étudie la conjecture des décompositions causales : tout canal unitaire admettrait une décomposition dont les connexions reflètent fidèlement sa structure causale. L’objectif est de développer des outils algébriques et syntaxiques pour étudier des cas ouverts, construire des décompositions ou identifier des obstructions. La recherche est exploratoire ; les résultats partiels et les limites des méthodes seront documentés.Vos principales missions seront de :Mener des recherches sur les décompositions causales des processus quantiques dans le cadre de la phase 1 du projet PIQ.Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat de projets étudiants et de stages.Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique de Télécom Paris, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris.  Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en physique, mathématiques, informatique ou dans une discipline pertinente pour le projet, obtenu au plus tard à la prise de fonctions. Vous devez posséder de solides connaissances en fondements quantiques, notamment en causalité quantique, ou en méthodes algébriques avancées, ainsi que de bonnes capacités de raisonnement mathématique, de démonstration et d’analyse critique. Vous devez être autonome dans la conduite de recherches théoriques, savoir rédiger des travaux scientifiques rigoureux et maîtriser l’anglais scientifique, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.Des connaissances en algèbres d’opérateurs, en information quantique et en formalismes diagrammatiques sont souhaitées. Une expérience en calcul symbolique ou numérique appliqué à des problèmes théoriques, ainsi qu’en encadrement d’étudiants, constitue un atout. Enfin, vous devez faire preuve d’un bon esprit d’équipe, de capacités de dialogue et de synthèse, ainsi que de solides qualités rédactionnelles et pédagogiques.Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers). description_clean: Empower every employee.AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Expect regular travel to customer sites, roughly 10 to 30 percent of your time.What you bring to the tableMust-havesAround 3 to 5 (or more) years in IT or tech consulting, customer engineering, forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering or SaaS implementation, with real enterprise exposure.Hands-on experience with enterprise integration and identity: SSO and authentication (OIDC, OAuth, Entra ID or comparable), REST APIs and API-based integrations delivered inside real enterprise IT environments.Customer-facing technical responsibility in enterprise projects, where you made the technical calls together with IT, security and functional departments rather than only coordinating them.Genuine technical depth without being a full-time production developer: you read code, review a design, debug an integration and build a working prototype.German at C1 level or above and fluent English.Nice-to-havesProvisioning experience (SCIM) and integrations into HR or workforce systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG.An informed, current view on where agentic AI is heading: MCP, A2A, EMA and the authentication questions underneath them. We are looking for someone who follows the field closely and has an opinion, not for years of experience that cannot exist yet.Prior work as a Customer Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer at a product company, rather than in classic consulting only.Workflow automation tooling (n8n or similar), comfort with logs, metrics and dashboards, or experience with German co-determination and enterprise data protection.What we offer youWork mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere.Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip AI in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed.Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters.Working abroad: At Flip AI you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.At Flip AI, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip AI. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
description_clean:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 
We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.
Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain.
This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.
We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:
At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:
In this role, you will:

Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.


 Your Profile:

5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
Fluent English required


Our hiring process:

title: Initiativbewerbung Büro Greifswald
description_clean:
Gestalte mit uns die Buchhaltung von morgen: cloudbasiert, KI-unterstützt, papierlos
Du brennst für Zahlen und möchtest die Finanzbuchhaltung nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv in die digitale Zukunft führen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig, unabhängig davon, wo du in deiner Karriere gerade stehst.

Junior-Finanzbuchhaltern (m/w/d), die nach ihrer Ausbildung oder ihrem Studium durchstarten und wachsen möchten,

Ob erste Berufserfahrung oder langjährige Expertise, bei uns findest du den passenden Platz und den Raum, dich weiterzuentwickeln.  
Deine möglichen Aufgabenfelder
Je nach Erfahrung und Spezialisierung:  

Betreuung unserer Mandantinnen und Mandanten mit modernsten Technologien
Mitwirkung an bis hin zur eigenverantwortlichen Führung der digitalen Finanzbuchhaltung
Vorbereitung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB und Finanzbuchhaltungsvorgaben
Kontenpflege, Kontenabstimmungen, Vorbereitung des Zahlungsverkehrs sowie Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen
Kontinuierliche Analyse und Optimierung der Buchhaltungsprozesse durch den Einsatz digitaler Tools
Gestaltung und Nutzung digitaler Workflows (z. B. Belegflüsse, Freigabeprozesse, Dokumentenmanagement)
Bei entsprechender Erfahrung: eigenverantwortliche Projektsteuerung  end-to-end  sowie, wenn vorhanden, das Einbringen deines eigenen Mandanten-Netzwerks zum Ausbau unseres Kundenportfolios

Was du mitbringen solltest
Wir wissen: Nicht jede/jeder erfüllt alles und das ist völlig in Ordnung. Bewirb dich, wenn ein Großteil auf dich zutrifft:  

Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein vergleichbares Studium
Berufserfahrung passend zu deiner Karrierestufe, von ersten praktischen Erfahrungen (Junior) über mehrjährige Buchhaltungspraxis bis hin zu 3 bis 5+ Jahren und fundierter Bilanzbuchhaltungserfahrung (Senior/Bilanzbuchhalter)
Idealerweise (für erfahrene Profile) Praxis aus einer Steuerkanzlei/einem Steuerbüro sowie Beteiligung an oder eigenständige Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen
Kenntnisse in HGB und Finanzbuchhaltung, je nach Level Grundkenntnisse oder umfassende Expertise
Begeisterung für digitale Innovationen und Erfahrung bzw. Offenheit im Umgang mit digitalen Workflows
Kenntnisse in Microsoft M365 und DATEV (Grundkenntnisse wünschenswert bis sicherer Umgang); Erfahrung mit Business Central, Oracle oder branchenspezifischen ERP-Systemen von Vorteil
Ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis, Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit
Eine selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit, digital wie persönlich
Von Vorteil (kein Muss): ein eigenes Mandanten-Netzwerk, das du mit einbringen möchtest

Was wir dir bieten

Gestaltungsspielraum: Bring deine Ideen ein und gestalte aktiv die Zukunft der Buchhaltung mit
Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Baue unser Team in Düsseldorf mit auf, mit echtem Raum für deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung
Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Bleib am Puls der digitalen Entwicklung, insbesondere bei Workflows und Automatisierung
Flexibles Arbeiten: Remote oder im modernen Büro mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen in der Düsseldorfer Altstadt, du hast die Wahl
Work-Life-Balance: 30 Urlaubstage, zusätzlich frei an Heiligabend und Silvester sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten
Mitarbeiter-Benefits: spendit-Karte, kostenlose Getränke, regelmäßige Teamevents (in Planung)
Mobilität: Fahrtkostenzuschuss für das Deutschlandticket und JobRad-Leasing

Über uns
Die advacc advanced accounting GmbH ist der Partner für moderne, vollständig digitale Buchhaltung mit Standorten in Düsseldorf und Greifswald. Als externe Buchhaltung übernehmen wir für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zentrale Aufgaben der Finanzbuchhaltung, von der Bearbeitung von Ein- und Ausgangsrechnungen über die Buchung aller Geschäftsvorfälle bis zur Lohnabrechnung und stellen fristgerechte, transparente und rechtssichere Abläufe sicher.Darüber hinaus beraten wir betriebswirtschaftlich, steuern das Forderungsmanagement und treiben die Digitalisierung sowie Optimierung von Buchhaltungsprozessen voran. Unser erfahrenes Team arbeitet softwareunabhängig, schnell und proaktiv, mit dem Anspruch, Abläufe zu vereinfachen, Liquidität zu sichern und Freiräume für das Kerngeschäft unserer Kundinnen und Kunden zu schaffen. Wir stehen für innovative Lösungen, hohe Serviceorientierung und echte Hands-on-Mentalität.Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Define approved configurations, test plans and readiness criteria. description_clean: About Niantic SpatialAI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.About the RoleWe are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will help build and train large models on large-scale multi-modal datasets, including our proprietary collection of 30 billion posed images and ship them into production, to be used by people and robots from all over the world.Our team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and other handheld devices, 360 cameras, vehicles, and drones, as well as aerial and satellite imagery, LiDAR, and external geographic data. Your focus will be to improve accuracy and robustness across urban and rural locations, cameras, seasons, weather, and capture quality. description_clean: About Orakl OncologyAt Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.The roleWe are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team.Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects.Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology.Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you.What you will doDesign and build the omics data architecture. Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack.Guarantee reliable ingestion. Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our data model definition.Build and maintain the omics data model. Maintain a curated reference layer as the single source of truth, keep model-ready datasets derived from it separate, and track lineage between the two so every model input can be traced back to its source.Make the data easy to use. Build and evolve the access layer so scientists and models get what they need for client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D, without writing joins or asking someone.What you bringMust-haves4+ years as a data engineer, with ingestion pipelines you built running in production.Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering (or equivalent experience)Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD for data pipelines and code libraries.Strong data modeling experience: you have designed schemas that handle evolving identifiers, versioning and lineage.Deep relational database expertise: schema design, partitioning, indexing, query plans, migrations on a live database.Deep cloud infrastructure skills: AWS (S3 and core services), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent) and containers (Docker), with sound judgment on what belongs in a database and what stays in files.Strong experience in Python and SQL; comfortable with Git, CI and the command line.You can propose architecture choices, defend them and converge with engineering peers.A real drive to understand omics, including how our data is processed, so you can step in for our Senior Bioinformatician when they are away.Nice-to-havesOmics experience: you have loaded VCF/MAF files or expression matrices. Familiarity with Nextflow / nf-core pipelines.Columnar formats and engines (Parquet, Arrow, DuckDB) and an orchestrator (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect).Metabase or another BI layer on top of a relational database.LIMS or biobank sample-tracking integration.A tech-bio background, or prior work next to bioinformaticians.What we offerMission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.Role: be the engineer behind the data backbone of a distinctive oncology discovery platform — designing, with our data engineering team, how one of the world’s rarest PDO multi-omics and functional datasets is stored, served and scaled, so that scientists and models can build on it every day.Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes.Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.Interview ProcessHiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience with production data pipelines, data modeling, and scientific data processing.Technical Case: A system-design and problem-solving exercise representative of the real wet-lab data challenges you'll face at Orakl.Reference Call: A conversation with one or two people you've worked with closely.Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.👉 More about Orakl here and hereFind Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Change.org, Germany - (snr Communications Manager)
description_clean: Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Communications Manager to lead our team in Germany, as Head of Change.org, Germany. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. The job also involves being the public voice of Change.org in the German media. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through an exceptional network, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle.We'd welcome ambitious Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role.Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions.What you will achieveCreate awareness spikes. Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events.Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win.Earn trust across the political spectrum. Make sure Change.org campaigns speak to people across the democratic political spectrum, and protect the trust in our brand as the team moves fast with AI. At a Senior Manager level, build balance checks into how the team works.Mobilise your network. Use and grow high-trust relationships with senior editors, producers, journalists, politicians, decision makers, civil society and creators to secure top-tier coverage and move decision makers.Be our voice. Act as Change.org's external spokesperson in Germany on TV, radio, in print and on stage, representing a trusted, open platform for people across the democratic political spectrum, including in sensitive and crisis situations.Lead a high-performing team. Set clear goals, coach and develop people, give direct feedback, and build a culture of speed, ambition and ownership. At a Senior Manager level, set team objectives, coach and develop each person on the team.Lead with AI. Build AI and agentic workflows into how the team spots stories, plans campaigns, pitches media and reports results, so the team works faster and smarter.What you bringA track record of viral campaigns. You have created campaigns that broke through nationally and drove measurable spikes in public attention, online and offline. You think in moments, images and headlines, and you move from idea to execution in hours, not weeks.Fast paced. You are skilled in fast and excellent execution with rapid pivots and changing contexts.A strong network. You have trusted relationships with German journalists, editors and producers (ideally including key decision makers), and connections in politics and civil society across the whole democratic political spectrum, including conservative circles. You can use your contacts to place stories.Management. You have led and developed a team, or have mentored others and are ready to step into leading one. You set priorities, give direct feedback and bring out the best in people. At a Senior Manager level, you would move resources as the news and priorities shift.Leadership presence. You are confident, credible and calm under pressure. You are an experienced, media-trained spokesperson on live TV and radio and in front of senior stakeholders, and you handle tough interviews, crisis moments and politically sensitive questions with ease.AI First: You use AI tools every day and have built or improved workflows and automations with them. You know where AI adds speed and quality and where human judgement matters most, and you bring your team along.Target experience5-8+ years in communications, campaigning, political communications, a newsroom or an agency.3+ years leading people, at Senior Manager level. It is a full-time hybrid role, and we expect you to be in the Berlin office 2-3 days per week, with flexibility to work remotely for the rest of the week.Our compensation philosophy is based on pay equity. All of our salaries are determined before we launch a role, based on a predetermined salary scale, the level on that scale and the cost of labour for that location. The annual salary for this role at Senior Manager level is €95,500 in Berlin. title: Senior Backend Engineer - Run & Grow
description_clean:
About the Run & Grow:
Run & Grow is where SumUp builds the platforms and capabilities that help merchants discover, join, use, and continue growing with our products. The tribe brings together engineering, product, design, and revenue operations teams around two connected goals: helping SumUp serve and retain merchants, and accelerating acquisition, activation, and engagement.
Our work sits at the heart of SumUp's growth engine. We turn complex challenges across merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, commercial systems, operations, risk, and compliance into reliable products and services that other teams can build on. The systems we create help SumUp move faster, make better decisions, and deliver a simpler experience to millions of small businesses.
Joining Run & Grow means working on high-impact engineering problems with a broad view of the business. You'll collaborate across disciplines and teams, shape the foundations behind important merchant journeys, and help create a more connected, scalable way for SumUp to run and grow.
 
What you'll do:

Design, build, and operate production-grade backend services, APIs, and integrations, primarily using Go.
Build event-driven workflows and distributed systems using technologies such as Kafka and asynchronous processing.
Define clear service boundaries, data models, schemas, and API contracts that other teams can use confidently.
Build capabilities supporting merchant acquisition, identity, marketing technology, operations, risk, and compliance.
Own technical work end to end, from discovery and system design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production follow-up.
Modernise existing services and improve reliability through observability, security, failure handling, and incident response.
Collaborate with Product, Data, Operations, Compliance, Risk, Sales, Marketing, and other engineering teams to turn complex requirements into practical solutions.
Review code and designs, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, share knowledge, and mentor engineers around you

 
You'll be great for this role if you:

Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable fintech, payments, or similar domains
Have experience with testing, observability, and incident response practices and treat them as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts
Take ownership of ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
Communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and explain technical concepts and trade-offs to different audiences.
Value pragmatic engineering, continuous improvement, mentoring, and reliable production operations.

 
Why you should join SumUp:
🌍 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup
🧑‍🔬 We take learning and experimentation seriously with Hack Days every second Friday, and entire global Hack Weeks.
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2,000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education
🚀 Enrolment onto our VSOP program: You will own a stake in SumUp's future success
💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions
🔄 30 Days Sabbatical: Enjoy the unique opportunity to take a well-deserved break with our 30 days sabbatical benefit after completing 3 years of employment with SumUp
🔗 Referral Bonus: Earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team
🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, relocation assistance, subsidised office lunches

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 36 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.
Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our mission
We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
description_clean: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process.This is a people leadership role with a hard technical requirement. The engineers report to you, so hiring, development, performance and pace are yours. At the same time you have to hold your own on system architecture: challenge estimates from your engineers, spar with the Product Tribe Lead on solutions, and know when a design is wrong before it ships. This role needs both.How we're set upTribes are the organisational body: people management, capacity, planning and reporting live there. Squads are assigned to problem spaces and run discovery and delivery, each led by a trio of Tech Lead, Product Manager and Product Designer. Tech Leads own the technical decisions in their squad, including estimates, and write code alongside their engineers. They don't manage people. You do.We keep the structure deliberately flat. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). Discovery and delivery run in parallel: the next mission is scoped before engineers finish the current one, so engineers weigh in on architecture early and have the context to unblock themselves.What you'll ownFeasibility and delivery for the tribe. You're accountable for tribe-wide delivery outcomes and velocity: the right problems, solved at the right quality, as fast as possible.The people. 15 to 20 direct reports. Hiring, onboarding, expectations, feedback, development, compensation and promotion recommendations, and the tough calls that keep talent density high. Tech Leads feed you performance signals; the decisions and the conversations are yours.Technical judgement across squads. Broad understanding of the tribe's systems and how they fit into the wider Moss architecture. You challenge estimates and technical proposals from your engineers; you don't produce the estimates yourself.A seat in the tribe trio. Roadmap and planning input through a feasibility lens. You argue solutions and trade-offs with the Product Tribe Lead as a technical peer, and push back on scope and timelines when the engineering picture says so.Operating rhythm. How the tribe plans, estimates, tracks and reports on delivery, with proactive, timely transparency to the tribe and to leadership, the good and the bad.Capacity. Putting your best people on the most impactful work, moving engineers between squads (and, where it serves Moss, between tribes) while still letting people build real domain depth.Alignment across tribes. Tribe leads aren't isolated trios. You align proactively with your peer Heads of Engineering and with platform and architecture owners, and you resolve shared-architecture questions through alignment, not around it.How we expect leaders to operateVelocity first, with high agency. Working smart and hard on the right problems.Lead by example, stay close to the work. You know the details of what your team is building and course-correct in real time. You get hands-on when speed or quality is on the line.End-to-end ownership of outcomes. Responsibility doesn't stop at your team's boundary. Make changes elsewhere when that's what it takes, communicating first, not unilaterally.No waterfall, no blame. Product, Design and Engineering work together from the start. If there's a gap in the trio, fill it or name it.Disagree and commit. Challenge when it matters. Once a call is made, own the message and explain the why, including for calls you argued against.Proactive expertise. We build expert products for finance teams. Decisions rest on real expertise, internal and external, not assumptions.Moss has one manager framework for every people leader, and this role is held to it in full: build a high-performing team, define success clearly, deliver results with your team, and operate with speed and ownership. You can hold us to it too.What you bring4 to 6+ years in engineering management, with a track record of managing engineers directly at a meaningful span. You've run hiring, performance management and difficult conversations yourself, not through a layer of managers.A senior engineering career before that. You've operated at senior or staff level as an engineer and your judgement on system design is current, not historical.Strong systems design. You can read an architecture, spot where it will break, and argue an alternative with the people who built it. You can tell a 2-week estimate from a 6-week one and explain why.Comfort as a technical peer to product leadership. You've shaped roadmaps and scope through feasibility arguments, and you've won and lost those arguments gracefully.Structure at scale without a middle layer. You build the practices that make 15 to 20 direct reports work: clear expectations, regular feedback, visible delivery.Fast in unfamiliar domains. You can reason about a new technical domain quickly and contribute before you have deep prior expertise in it.Experience from an environment with mature engineering practices: code review, testing, incident handling, planning and estimation that actually work. You know what good looks like and can build it where it's missing.Strong plusesBackground at an AI product company or in ERP / financial systems. Both are directly relevant to what we build.Experience leading in a flat or tribe/squad-style organisation.Experience with a Tech Lead / Engineering Manager split, as either side of it.What this role is, and isn'tIt's worth being clear about the shape of the job. Your technical contribution is judgement, challenge and architecture-level input; Tech Leads own the how and write the code alongside their squads, so this isn't a role with an IC workload attached. And it's a role where you manage engineers, not managers: every engineer in the tribe reports to you directly, there is no management layer beneath you, and we don't plan to add one. If that combination of deep people leadership and real technical engagement is what you're looking for, you'll find a lot to like here.About MossMoss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our Data Privacy Policy.Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Du verantwortest unsere Wissensdatenbank: Du hältst sie aktuell, vollständig und widerspruchsfrei, für Lumi, unsere internen KI-Tools und unser Team.

Du entwickelst Frühwarnsysteme, die abwanderungsgefährdete Kund:innen erkennen, bevor sie kündigen, und stößt passende Maßnahmen an.
Du zeigst unseren Fachabteilungen, was unsere Kund:innen brauchen und wo Probleme entstehen.
Du findest gemeinsam mit Customer Service und Technical Support heraus, welche Anliegen künftig direkt im ersten Kontakt gelöst werden können.
Du beantwortest Bewertungen auf Trustpilot, in den App Stores und bei Google.
Du entwickelst unsere Standardkommunikation weiter, prüfst Zustellbarkeit und Wirkung und testest Varianten.
Du lieferst unserem Produktteam auf Basis der Daten Inhalte und Anlässe, damit wir Kund:innen in allen Kanälen, auch in unserer App, im richtigen Moment informieren.

Dein Profil

Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Customer Experience, Customer Insights, CRM oder einem verwandten Bereich und hast dort schon eigene Themen verantwortet.
Du arbeitest täglich mit KI: Du schreibst gute Prompts und prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch.

Du hast Kundendaten selbst ausgewertet und daraus konkrete Verbesserungen abgeleitet.
Du behältst bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick, priorisierst selbst und lieferst Ergebnisse, die nicht nachgeschärft werden müssen.
Du denkst in Prozessen und gibst Dich nicht mit Symptomen zufrieden.
Du schreibst klar und kannst auch Themen wie Smart Meter oder dynamische Tarife verständlich erklären. Auch bei einer wütenden Bewertung triffst Du den richtigen Ton.
Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gutes Deutsch (C2).
Erfahrung mit Wissensdatenbanken, HubSpot oder Bewertungsplattformen ist ein Plus.

Unser Offer

Wirkung, die bleibt: Deine Insights und Projekte entscheiden mit, ob Kund:innen dauerhaft bei SpotmyEnergy bleiben. Das zahlt direkt auf unser Wachstum ein.
Echte Gestaltung: Du entscheidest, was Lumi, unsere internen KI-Tools und alle Mitarbeitenden über unsere Produkte wissen.
KI im Alltag statt auf Folien: Du arbeitest mit den Tools, die wir täglich einsetzen, und baust auf Analysen auf, die schon vorbereitet sind.
Nah an den Entscheidungen: Du berichtest direkt an unsere VP Customer Experience und arbeitest eng mit Customer Service, Technical Support und Produkt zusammen.
Energiewende mitgestalten: ein Scale-up, das gerade stark wächst, mit Büro in Köln und einem starken Teamspirit.

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.
We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.
